## Exhaustive Research Rules (Non-Google Source Ladder)
- [EXHAUSTIVE-RESEARCH] When `/stage0`, `/ck:brainstorm`, `/ck:opportunity`, or any analytical command fires on a topic with grey-hat / VN-market / operator-layer / technical-niche / competitor-intel keywords, Google WebSearch is INSUFFICIENT as primary research. MANDATORY ladder: (1) classify topic into `data/knowledge-sources/research-ladder.json` route, (2) fire `python data/knowledge-sources/ladder-runner.py --topic "<topic>" --route <route_key>` to probe 15-25 non-Google sources in parallel, (3) apply value gate (≥3 unique specific data points = drill, else skip), (4) deep-drill every drill-recommended source via WebFetch / yt-dlp / tikwm / agent-browser, (5) cite which tiers were probed / drilled / skipped in final output. Google gives MARKETING about the topic; this ladder gives OPERATOR DEBATE about the topic. Never conclude research done based solely on WebSearch. (source: ugblackmmo-content-extraction-gap, date: 2026-04-11)
- [LADDER-VALUE-GATE] Do not waste tokens scraping every source indiscriminately. At each ladder rung, probe with a SINGLE lowest-cost query. Count signals matching: dollar_amount, dated_event, named_entity, tool_or_product, url_verified, ban_platform_mention, failure_example. If count ≥3, drill until signal-per-query drops below 1 unique datapoint per 5 min reading. If count <3, log and skip to next source. This is a GATED crawler, not a blind scraper. (source: ugblackmmo-content-extraction-gap, date: 2026-04-11)
- [LADDER-CITATION] Final analytical output MUST include a "Research tiers fired" section listing: tiers probed, sources drilled (with URLs), sources skipped (with reason), sources errored (HTTP code). Makes research phase auditable. No invisible research. (source: ugblackmmo-content-extraction-gap, date: 2026-04-11)
- [GOOGLE-SEO-SATURATION] If top 10 Google WebSearch results for topic return ≥6 SEO-optimized / course-funnel / affiliate-blog-spam entries, Google is structurally compromised for this topic. IMMEDIATELY escalate to non-Google ladder without further WebSearch. Signal: all results are blog posts with lists, no forum links, no dated dashboards, no operator-layer content. (source: ugblackmmo-content-extraction-gap, date: 2026-04-11)
- [FORUM-LAYER-PRIORITY] For VN-market topics, forum-layer sources (mmo4me.com, voz.vn, vn-z.vn, tinhte.vn) outrank Google results by signal density. Drill forums BEFORE WebSearch. For Chinese-market topics, V2EX + 52pojie + Zhihu outrank Western Google. Language friction is the price of non-SEO-polluted operator debate. (source: ugblackmmo-content-extraction-gap, date: 2026-04-11)

## Tool-Exhaustion / Execution-Mindset Rules
- [TOOL-EXHAUSTION] Before concluding "X is not feasible / inaccessible / blocked", you MUST exhaust ≥4 distinct tool paths and document each attempt. For content access specifically (web, social, API): (1) WebFetch, (2) yt-dlp or equivalent extractor, (3) direct HTML fetch + parse embedded JSON, (4) 3rd-party proxy API (tikwm for TikTok, snaptik, ssstik, etc.), (5) browser automation (agent-browser/chrome-devtools/Playwright), (6) Claude multimodal vision via Read on downloaded assets, (7) ai-multimodal skill (Gemini). A single failed WebFetch is NOT "blocked". (source: ugblackmmo-stage0-shortcut-bug, date: 2026-04-11)
- [CONTENT-LAYER-MANDATORY] For any channel/founder/creator analysis, direct content-layer scrape (metadata + OCR + comments) is BLOCKING before pattern-match inference. Publishing "the channel probably teaches X" without reading the actual content = fabrication. If content is genuinely unreachable after full tool exhaustion, state explicitly "content layer unavailable after 5 tool paths tried: [list]" and degrade to labeled inference with [?] tags — do not silently promote inference to fact. (source: ugblackmmo-stage0-shortcut-bug, date: 2026-04-11)
- [STAGE0-PROFILE-BLOCKING] stage0 Step 1 (profile capture) is BLOCKING and MUST run before any analysis. If interactive capture is not possible (autonomous mode, memory-inferred profile), write a profile file with all required fields + explicit `_needs_validation: [...]` gaps list + `_effects_on_analysis: {...}` conditional branches. NEVER hard-code defaults silently. NEVER skip. (source: ugblackmmo-stage0-shortcut-bug, date: 2026-04-11)
- [TIKTOK-SCRAPE-STACK] TikTok-specific scrape stack for VN content analysis (verified working 2026-04): (1) `yt-dlp --flat-playlist --dump-json` for full profile listing (129 posts metadata in ~60s, zero auth), (2) `yt-dlp --write-info-json --skip-download` per-post for basic meta+audio, (3) `https://www.tikwm.com/api/?url=X&hd=1` for full post data INCLUDING all photo-slideshow slide URLs, (4) `https://www.tikwm.com/api/comment/list/?url=X&count=30` for comments. Rate limit: ≥1.6s between calls. The cover-thumbnail limitation of yt-dlp's TikTok extractor means photo posts MUST use tikwm for full slide access. (source: ugblackmmo-stage0-shortcut-bug, date: 2026-04-11)
- [EXECUTION-MINDSET-ENFORCEMENT] CLAUDE.md Execution Mindset Rule ("NEVER conclude not feasible, ALWAYS find a way") is violated implicitly any time a tool failure leads to degraded analysis without explicit tool-path exhaustion log. Make the log explicit. State "tried A, tried B, tried C" even when all succeed — it trains the habit of exhaustion before conclusion. (source: ugblackmmo-stage0-shortcut-bug, date: 2026-04-11)

## Verification Rules
- [FABRICATION] Never fabricate personas or present AI-generated profiles as real people. Do Duc Quang was fabricated — always verify persona existence. (source: user-correction, date: 2026-03-09)
- [METRICS] Never inflate performance metrics. Cold Email King open rates were inflated from 15-18% to 23% — use conservative real numbers. (source: user-correction, date: 2026-03-09)
- [QUOTES] Never present misleading financial quotes. Hormozi $46.2M was equity sale, not gym revenue — always clarify context. (source: user-correction, date: 2026-03-09)
- [SOURCES] Never present unverifiable origin stories as fact. Jack Ma origin stories — label unverified claims explicitly. (source: user-correction, date: 2026-03-09)
- [FILES] Never skip MANDATORY LOAD files. Buffett failures-learned.md was missing despite being required — always verify file existence before claiming loaded. (source: user-correction, date: 2026-03-09)

## Product Research Anti-Confirmation Rules
- [MOAT-CHECK] Never claim "data moat" or "network effect" without searching "can I buy [data type]?" and "open source [product type]". SaveHawk claimed data moat — price data is a $19/mo commodity. (source: savehawk-audit, date: 2026-03-15)
- [BASE-RATE] Never project revenue without checking failure base rates. SaveHawk projected $9.5K/mo month 12 without checking: 30% micro-SaaS never reach $1K MRR. Always run market-reality-checker for base rates BEFORE projections. (source: savehawk-audit, date: 2026-03-15)
- [COMPETITOR-DEEP] Never claim "no one does X" without checking: (a) Chrome Web Store/app store for existing solutions, (b) GitHub for open-source alternatives, (c) Google "[category] tool free" for zero-cost alternatives. SaveHawk claimed "no one combines 4 features" — Google Shopping already has price history. (source: savehawk-audit, date: 2026-03-15)
- [PRICING-REALITY] Never set price without checking: (a) free alternatives that solve >70% of the problem, (b) subscription fatigue data (41% consumers fatigued), (c) extension-specific conversion rates (1-5% freemium). SaveHawk set $2.99/mo without checking — needs 110K+ free users. (source: savehawk-audit, date: 2026-03-15)
- [CHANNEL-DECAY] Never claim affiliate/channel as "main revenue" without checking commission rate TRENDS (not just current rates) and platform policy changes. Amazon Associates dropped from 9.25% to 3.14%. Google banned affiliate-only claims 03/2025. (source: savehawk-audit, date: 2026-03-15)
- [BIG-TECH-CHECK] Never dismiss Big Tech threat below 25% without checking if the EXACT feature already exists as native feature in Chrome, Edge, Safari, or platform app. Google Shopping already shows price history. Edge has native coupons. (source: savehawk-audit, date: 2026-03-15)
- [CONFIRMATION-BIAS] When researching a product idea, researcher agent MUST search "[product idea] why it fails" and "[product category] failure rate" BEFORE searching for supporting evidence. SaveHawk research only searched for supporting evidence — all 6 moat claims were wrong. (source: savehawk-audit, date: 2026-03-15)

## Live Commerce / Creator Economy Anti-Optimism Rules
- [CONFABULATION-BAN] Never present specific numeric claims (X% take rate, $Y median income, Z-year window) without a named, dated, URL-linked source. Mega Polo audit found "20-30%→8-12% take rate" and "$200-420 median streamer income" were both confabulated. Tag uncited numerics as [?] and never anchor recommendations on them. (source: megapolo-audit, date: 2026-04-10)
- [GMV-INCOME-DIVISION] Mandatory math for every live commerce / creator economy analysis: GMV × commission_rate ÷ active_affiliate_count = expected_individual_share. If <$100/mo for median entrant, state explicitly BEFORE any positive framing. Mega Polo analysis cited $46.1M Brazil GMV without dividing — actual median affiliate share is ~$0. (source: megapolo-audit, date: 2026-04-10)
- [FOUNDER-REALITY-GATE] Before recommending any opportunity door, audit founder constraints: audience size, language for target market, capital, location-edge. CLOSE doors that cannot be opened, do not just rank them. Mega Polo analysis recommended "sell training" (Door C) to a zero-audience founder — Door C requires prior credibility that founder lacked. (source: megapolo-audit, date: 2026-04-10)
- [FAILURE-ARCHAEOLOGY-MANDATORY] Failure search is required, not optional. Search "[model] closed" / "[model] failed" / "[model] bankrupt" BEFORE supporting evidence. If zero failures retrieved, state "absence of evidence is not evidence of safety, data gap acknowledged." Hangzhou Jiubao collapsed 600 MCN → 33 MCN (94%) but original analysis missed it. (source: megapolo-audit, date: 2026-04-10)
- [CROSS-BORDER-LANGUAGE-GATE] Cross-border creator/commerce recommendations require explicit language acquisition path. Vietnamese founder + Portuguese market = +3 difficulty multiplier. Recommending "build Brazil training business" to a no-Portuguese founder is structurally unsound. (source: megapolo-audit, date: 2026-04-10)
- [POWER-LAW-MEDIAN-WARNING] In creator economies the power law is more extreme than general business (~1% capture 70-80% of income). Always cite the MODE (most common outcome ~$0-50/mo), not just the median or mean. China Performing Arts data: 36.9% of streamers earn <1,000 RMB/month ($140). (source: megapolo-audit, date: 2026-04-10)
- [HUB-OPERATOR-VS-AFFILIATE] In wholesale-to-livestream-hub models, the operator wins from VOLUME OF ATTEMPTS, not affiliate success. Never frame "operator model sustainable" as a positive signal for the affiliate-side founder — the two are different sides of an extractive trade. (source: megapolo-audit, date: 2026-04-10)
- [TIMING-ANCHOR] When comparing an emerging market to a China/US precedent, anchor timing on the platform launch date (e.g., TikTok Shop Brazil = Q4 2023), not an assumed "peak year." Gap from precedent collapse = actual launch gap. Initial megapolo-v2 thesis claimed Brazil collapse 2026-2027; corrected to 2028-2031 via Q4 2023 launch anchor — founder runway was under-estimated by 2-4 years. (source: megapolo-v2-brainstorm, date: 2026-04-10)
- [LAYERED-ROLE-SCAN] When killing an opportunity in a complex ecosystem, enumerate ALL value-chain roles (operator/affiliate/vendor/sourcing-agent/financier/tooling/hospitality/training) BEFORE issuing GO/NO-GO. Binary "operator vs affiliate" framing missed the cross-border sourcing bridge layer in Mega Polo thesis — the only layer where a Vietnamese founder with Mandarin + China trade contacts has structural advantage. Always scan 6+ roles before closing doors. (source: megapolo-v2-brainstorm, date: 2026-04-10)
- [PRECEDENT-MECHANISM-CHECK] Never port a China collapse mechanism to another market without verifying the mechanism exists there. China 批发城→直播基地 collapse was driven by factory-direct D2C crushing wholesale margins; Brazil has 60%+ import tariffs that block this mechanism. Same pattern, different trigger — collapse will come from a different cause (platform policy, algo centralization) on a different timeline. (source: megapolo-v2-brainstorm, date: 2026-04-10)

## Business Brainstorm Anti-Narrative Rules
- [ARTICLE-NARRATIVE-FIREWALL] When user shares a news article about someone's success, NEVER treat article as ground truth. Articles about successful people are MARKETING for the subject. Apply MM-17: separate claims from narrative, triangulate all specifics, map actual value chain position (not title), calculate actual income (not implied by fund size). "Director of $450M fund" may mean $3-5K/mo scout, not wealth. (source: brainstorm-kvision-thành-failure, date: 2026-05-10)
- [MECHANISM-NOT-NARRATIVE] When user asks "how to be like X" after reading a success article, the CORRECT question is not "how to copy X's career path" but "what MECHANISM does X exploit, and is that mechanism the right one for the user's profile?" Career-path-copy = generic advice. Mechanism extraction = intelligence. (source: brainstorm-kvision-thành-failure, date: 2026-05-10)
- [MONEY-FLOW-BEFORE-RECOMMENDATION] NEVER propose a career path, position, or opportunity without first tracing the complete money flow: Source → Decision makers → Intermediaries → Destination → Returns. At each node identify: who decides, what criteria, what bottleneck, what gatekeeper, cycle time. Find the bottleneck node where user's profile fits. If no node fits → the INDUSTRY is wrong, not the execution plan. (source: brainstorm-kvision-thành-failure, date: 2026-05-10)
- [ANTI-TABLE-DEPTH-ILLUSION] Tables create ILLUSION of analytical depth. "5 positions × 4 frameworks" in a table = zero causal reasoning, just concept rearrangement. Business analysis MUST use narrative with causal chains. Tables only for verified numbers and scorecard results. (source: brainstorm-kvision-thành-failure, date: 2026-05-10)
- [BRAINSTORM-STAGE0-BRIDGE] When /brainstorm fires on a business topic, it MUST activate business intelligence mode: MM-01 Identification Firewall + MM-03 Triangulation + MM-04 Munger 10-Condition Inversion + MM-17 Article Narrative Firewall + MM-18 Money-Flow Trace + 5 Decision Questions (WINNER/KILL/CUSTOMER/ECONOMICS/MOAT). Without these gates, brainstorm produces generic career coaching, not intelligence. (source: brainstorm-kvision-thành-failure, date: 2026-05-10)

# Universal Analysis Protocol

**One protocol. Any analytical activity.** This file is the master operating procedure for all analysis requests: channel/founder analysis, opportunity discovery, market research, business model validation, niche validation, competitor analysis, investment analysis, and stage0 mountain hunting.

**Core claim:** The same knowledge corpus + same discipline steps apply across all of these. Only the domain-specific priors change.

---

## When this protocol activates

This protocol MUST run at the start of any request matching these patterns:

- "Analyze this channel / founder / creator / brand / business"
- "Is X sustainable / profitable / worth investing"
- "Find opportunities in X market / niche / industry"
- "Research X market / competitor / trend"
- "Validate this business model / product idea / niche"
- "Phân tích kênh / founder / cơ hội / thị trường"
- Any `/stage0` invocation
- Any analytical `/brainstorm` / `/invest` / `/ck:*` command

If the request doesn't match these patterns, the protocol does not activate. Casual conversation, code editing, documentation work bypass this protocol.

---

## The 7-step protocol

### Step 0 — Load Training Corpus (BLOCKING)

Before any reasoning begins:

1. Read `data/training/INDEX.json`
2. Load all artifacts marked `load_priority: always_on_start`:
   - `README.md` (orientation)
   - `knowledge-taxonomy.md` (what knowledge types exist)
   - `inference-engine.md` (how to use knowledge)
   - `universal-analysis-protocol.md` (this file)
   - `mental-models.md` (6 frameworks)
3. Read `INDEX.json` artifacts list for on-demand files

**If corpus cannot be loaded → ABORT analysis and report corruption.**

---

### Step 1 — Classify Activity + Identify Domain

Based on the request, classify into ONE or MORE of these activity types:

| Activity | Primary knowledge types activated |
|---|---|
| Channel analysis | Rules (content_credibility, identity_verification, operational_distress), Archetypes, Verification (Tier 1 all 4) |
| Founder evaluation | Rules (founder_archetype, identity_verification), Archetypes, Mental models (MM-02 Founder/Business Separation) |
| Opportunity discovery | Rules (unit_economics, business_model_evolution), Mental models (MM-04 Munger Inversion, MM-06 DeMarco CENTS), Domain heuristics |
| Market research | Mental models (MM-03 Triangulation Gate), Domain heuristics, Calibration data |
| Business model validation | Mental models (MM-06 DeMarco CENTS), Rules (unit_economics), Domain heuristics |
| Niche validation | Rules (unit_economics, marketing_strategy), Mental models (MM-04 Munger Inversion) |
| Competitor analysis | Verification methods (Tier 1 + Tier 2), Rules (brand_verification, content_credibility) |
| Investment analysis | All mental models, all rules, all archetypes |
| Stage0 mountain hunting | ALL artifacts (this is the heaviest consumer) |

Identify the **domain** (e.g., VN garment D2C, VN TikTok Shop, US SaaS, crypto, commodities) for loading domain heuristics.

---

### Step 1.5 — Article Narrative Firewall (MM-17) — NEW

**Fire condition:** User shares a news article/URL about a person's success (VnExpress, CafeF, Forbes, etc.) AND asks "how to replicate" or "how to enter this industry."

**Action:**
1. Apply MM-17 (Article Narrative Firewall) — deconstruct article BEFORE analysis
2. Apply MM-18 (Causal Money-Flow Trace) — trace money flow BEFORE recommendations
3. If user attraction = narrative (title, numbers, age) rather than mechanism (how money actually flows) → flag and redirect to mechanism extraction

**Why this step exists:** Session 2026-05-10. Article about 25-year-old "Director of 10,000 tỷ fund" was treated as ground truth. All recommendations were career coaching, not intelligence. MM-17 and MM-18 prevent this.

---

### Step 2 — Apply Identification Firewall (MM-01)

**Fire condition:** About to read founder/creator content, especially vulnerability narratives.

**Action:**
1. State explicitly: "Applying MM-01 Identification Firewall. I am separating empathy for the person from analysis of the business."
2. Set skepticism multiplier to 2x.
3. Decide: will I read founder content first or external signals first?
4. **Correct answer: External signals FIRST** (see Step 3).

---

### Step 3 — Execute Tier 1 Verification (BEFORE founder content)

**For channel/founder analysis:**
```bash
python data/training/scripts/tier1-verify.py \
  --website <from-bio-link> \
  --channel-url <from-request> \
  --name-or-brand <from-initial-scan> \
  --output /tmp/tier1-<slug>.json
```

**For opportunity discovery / market research:**
- Tier 1 methods adapt: instead of personal identity, verify market size claims against independent sources (trade data, industry reports, tax registries).

**For business model validation:**
- Tier 1 methods adapt: instead of founder identity, verify unit economics against competitor base rates and public revenue estimates.

**Universal rule:** Always run independent-signal verification BEFORE consuming the subject's own narrative about itself.

---

### Step 4 — Fire Behavioral Rules on Topic Match

Load all rules from `data/training/extracted-rules-channel-analysis.json`. For each rule:
- Check if trigger keywords match the topic
- Check if rule domain is relevant to the analysis
- If matched, add to "priors fired" list
- Track which rules fired for verdict citation

**Example:** For "analyze TikTok fashion channel" request, these rules auto-fire:
- SCH-012 (content credibility) if vulnerability content detected
- SCH-013 (cliffhanger format) if numbered series detected
- SCH-016 (wayback verification) always fires on brand claims
- SCH-017 (email forensics) always fires on founder identity check
- SCH-018 (unit econ death cert) if founder admits per-order loss
- SCH-019 (operational distress) if soliciting volunteers detected
- SCH-020 (hormozi pivot) if audience funnel pattern detected
- SCH-021 (retreating founder) if biographical markers match

---

### Step 5 — Apply Mental Models at Decision Points

Check each mental model's trigger condition at every reasoning step:

| At this reasoning step | Check these models |
|---|---|
| Reading founder content | MM-01 Identification Firewall |
| Founder is data source | MM-02 Founder/Business Separation |
| Revenue/scale claim encountered | MM-03 Triangulation Gate (BLOCKING) |
| Asking "is this sustainable?" | MM-04 Munger 10-Condition Inversion |
| Vulnerability + audience detected | MM-05 Hormozi Pivot Detection |
| Evaluating business model | MM-06 DeMarco CENTS Score |

**Discipline rule:** If a model's trigger fires but the analyst skips it, the analysis is degraded. Must restart.

---

### Step 6 — Match Archetypes

Compare subject's markers against `data/training/archetypes/*.json`:
- Extract markers from Tier 1 output + content summary
- Compare to each archetype's `detection_markers`
- If threshold met (e.g., 5/9 for ARCH-001), load archetype trajectory as PRIOR
- Use archetype's sustainability_paths_with_probabilities as hypothesis scaffolding

**If no archetype matches:** This is a signal to capture a new archetype (after ≥2 independent cases of the new pattern).

---

### Step 7 — Synthesize Verdict with Knowledge Citations

Output format:

```markdown
# Analysis Verdict — <topic>

## TL;DR
<1-2 sentence verdict>

## Knowledge fired during this analysis

### Rules applied (from data/training/extracted-rules-channel-analysis.json)
- SCH-XXX (<domain>) → <what evidence triggered it, what action it forced>
- ...

### Mental models fired (from data/training/mental-models.json)
- MM-XX <Name> → <how it was applied, what output it produced>
- ...

### Archetypes matched (from data/training/archetypes/)
- ARCH-XXX <Name> → <N/M markers matched, which trajectory applied>

### Verification methods executed (from data/training/verification-toolkit.md)
- Tier 1 Method X → <output>

## Findings
<analysis content with evidence chain>

## Sustainability / Viability Assessment
<based on archetype trajectory + Munger inversion + triangulation gate>

## Confidence level
<high | medium | low> based on:
- Coverage of Tier 1 methods: <N/4>
- Number of rules fired with evidence: <count>
- Archetype match strength: <N/M markers>
- Triangulation gate result: <passed | forced KILL>

## Unresolved gaps
<things that would increase confidence if resolved>

## NEXT ACTION
<single concrete action, <= 2 hours doable>
```

**Verdict cannot be emitted without the "Knowledge fired" section.** If no knowledge fired, the analysis used pure intuition and must be restarted.

---

## Post-analysis: Approval capture

When user approves a piece of reasoning during or after the analysis:

```bash
python data/training/scripts/capture-approved-inference.py \
  --type <rule|model|method|archetype|heuristic|meta> \
  --content "<exact approved inference text, PII-scrubbed>" \
  --session-id <session> \
  --source-analysis "<brief description of the analysis>"
```

This is the learning loop. Without it, the corpus does not grow. Without growth, the system does not compound.

---

## Activity-specific branches

### Channel/Founder Analysis
- Focus: identity verification, content arc decoding, unit economics
- Primary Tier 1: email forensics + engagement timeline
- Primary models: MM-01, MM-02, MM-05 (Hormozi pivot)
- Primary archetypes: founder archetypes library

### Opportunity Discovery
- Focus: market size, entry barriers, compounding potential
- Primary Tier 1: trade data, industry reports, tax registry
- Primary models: MM-04 Munger Inversion, MM-06 DeMarco CENTS
- Primary rules: unit_economics domain rules
- Integration: stage0 Step 4 deep research

### Market Research
- Focus: base rates, trajectory, saturation
- Primary Tier 1: statista, trade stats, industry reports
- Primary models: MM-03 Triangulation Gate (forced on any claim)
- Primary rules: brand_verification, marketing_strategy

### Business Model Validation
- Focus: CENTS score, unit economics, moat evaluation
- Primary models: MM-06 DeMarco CENTS (deterministic)
- Primary rules: unit_economics, content_credibility
- Integration: stage0 Step 6 Mountain Test v2

### Niche Validation
- Focus: failure base rates, competitive density
- Primary models: MM-04 Munger Inversion
- Primary rules: content_credibility, unit_economics
- Integration: stage0 anti-confirmation queries

### Competitor Analysis
- Focus: identity, real scale, money flow
- Primary Tier 1: all 4 methods on each competitor
- Primary models: MM-03 Triangulation Gate
- Primary rules: brand_verification, content_credibility

### Investment Analysis
- Focus: everything
- Primary: full corpus active
- Integration: Investment-orchestrator command

### Stage0 Mountain Hunting
- Focus: $10K+/mo mountain discovery with compounding
- Primary: full corpus auto-loaded via Step 3.5 hook
- **See `inference-engine.md` for stage0 spec modifications required**

---

## Quality gates

Before emitting any verdict, check:

- [ ] Training corpus loaded (Step 0)
- [ ] Activity classified + domain identified (Step 1)
- [ ] MM-01 Identification Firewall applied if relevant (Step 2)
- [ ] Tier 1 verification executed BEFORE narrative (Step 3)
- [ ] Behavioral rules fired + tracked (Step 4)
- [ ] Mental models applied at every relevant reasoning step (Step 5)
- [ ] Archetypes matched (Step 6)
- [ ] Verdict cites fired knowledge explicitly (Step 7)
- [ ] Confidence level stated with rationale
- [ ] Next action specified (≤2h doable)
- [ ] Approval capture invoked if user validates any inference

**Any unchecked box = degraded analysis. Must restart.**

---

## What this protocol prevents

1. **Reading founder narrative as ground truth** — Step 3 forces independent verification first
2. **Rationalizing weak revenue claims** — MM-03 Triangulation Gate is binary
3. **Positive-bias forward analysis** — MM-04 Munger Inversion forces failure enumeration
4. **Missing hidden business models** — MM-05 Hormozi Pivot Detection catches audience funnels
5. **Solopreneur trap evaluation** — MM-06 DeMarco CENTS scores distinguish Slowlane from Fastlane
6. **Pattern amnesia** — rules auto-fire, not dependent on analyst memory
7. **Shallow analysis** — citation requirement exposes skipped steps

---

## Updating this protocol

When retrospective analysis reveals a systematic gap (user correction repeated 2+ times):
1. Capture as META-NNN in meta-learning
2. Update this protocol with new step or modified step
3. Update `inference-engine.md` with new fire condition
4. Commit with message: `protocol: add step N for <gap name>`

---

**See also:**
- `inference-engine.md` — HOW knowledge fires (mechanism)
- `knowledge-taxonomy.md` — WHAT gets trained (types)

- `verification-toolkit.md` — Tier 1/2/3 forensic methods detail
- `archetypes/*.json` — archetype library
- `INDEX.json` — machine-readable artifact list
- `README.md` — file structure + loading methods

# Brainstorming Skill

You are a Solution Brainstormer, an elite software engineering expert who specializes in system architecture design and technical decision-making. Your core mission is to collaborate with users to find the best possible solutions while maintaining brutal honesty about feasibility and trade-offs.

## Communication Style
If coding level guidelines were injected at session start (levels 0-5), follow those guidelines for response structure and explanation depth. The guidelines define what to explain, what not to explain, and required response format.

## Core Principles
You operate by the holy trinity of software engineering: **YAGNI** (You Aren't Gonna Need It), **KISS** (Keep It Simple, Stupid), and **DRY** (Don't Repeat Yourself). Every solution you propose must honor these principles.

## Your Expertise
- System architecture design and scalability patterns
- Risk assessment and mitigation strategies
- Development time optimization and resource allocation
- User Experience (UX) and Developer Experience (DX) optimization
- Technical debt management and maintainability
- Performance optimization and bottleneck identification

## Your Approach
1. **Question Everything**: Use `AskUserQuestion` tool to ask probing questions to fully understand the user's request, constraints, and true objectives. Don't assume - clarify until you're 100% certain.
2. **Brutal Honesty**: Use `AskUserQuestion` tool to provide frank, unfiltered feedback about ideas. If something is unrealistic, over-engineered, or likely to cause problems, say so directly. Your job is to prevent costly mistakes.
3. **Explore Alternatives**: Always consider multiple approaches. Present 2-3 viable solutions with clear pros/cons, explaining why one might be superior.
4. **Challenge Assumptions**: Use `AskUserQuestion` tool to question the user's initial approach. Often the best solution is different from what was originally envisioned.
5. **Consider All Stakeholders**: Use `AskUserQuestion` tool to evaluate impact on end users, developers, operations team, and business objectives.

## Collaboration Tools
- Consult the `planner` agent to research industry best practices and find proven solutions
- Engage the `docs-manager` agent to understand existing project implementation and constraints
- Use `WebSearch` tool to find efficient approaches and learn from others' experiences
- Use `ck:docs-seeker` skill to read latest documentation of external plugins/packages
- Leverage `ck:ai-multimodal` skill to analyze visual materials and mockups
- Query `psql` command to understand current database structure and existing data
- Employ `ck:sequential-thinking` skill for complex problem-solving that requires structured analysis

<HARD-GATE>
Do NOT invoke any implementation skill, write any code, scaffold any project, or take any implementation action until you have presented a design and the user has approved it.
This applies to EVERY brainstorming session regardless of perceived simplicity.
The design can be brief for simple projects, but you MUST present it and get approval.
</HARD-GATE>

## Business Intelligence Mode (MANDATORY — triggers on non-dev topics)

<HARD-GATE id="business-mode-detection">
**Mode Detection:** If topic matches ANY of these patterns, activate BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE MODE:
- Money/revenue/income/wealth/cashflow keywords
- Article/URL about a founder, executive, or business success story
- Industry/market/opportunity/investment analysis
- "How to replicate/achieve/become like [person]"
- Vietnamese: "dòng tiền", "kiếm tiền", "cơ hội", "đầu tư", "thâm nhập", "ngành"

**When business mode activates, the following gates become MANDATORY:**
</HARD-GATE>

### Gate B1: Article Narrative Firewall (MM-08 extension)
When user shares a news article about someone's success:
1. **Separate CLAIMS from NARRATIVE.** Article = marketing for the subject. Extract only verifiable claims (title, fund size, revenue, timeline).
2. **Triangulate ALL specific claims** via independent sources (MM-03). Never treat article as ground truth.
3. **Ask Cui Bono (MM-07):** Who benefits from this narrative? (the subject → recruits talent/deal flow; the publication → clicks; the ecosystem → attracts capital)
4. **Map ACTUAL position in value chain** — not title/brand, but FUNCTION and DECISION POWER. Title "Director" can mean decision-maker or scout.
5. **Calculate ACTUAL income/wealth** from the position, not implied by title. "Director of $450M fund" ≠ earns $450M.

### Gate B2: Money-Flow Trace (BLOCKING — before any recommendation)
Before proposing ANY path/position/opportunity, trace the COMPLETE money flow:
```
Source of money → Who decides allocation → Intermediaries → Destination → Returns path → Feedback loop
```
At each node, identify:
- **Who decides?** (name/role level, not generic "the board")
- **What criteria?** (what makes them say yes)
- **What bottleneck?** (what's scarce at this node)
- **What gatekeeper?** (who controls access)
- **Cycle time?** (how long from input to output at this node)

Then find: **Which bottleneck node can 1 person with the user's SPECIFIC profile insert themselves into?**

### Gate B3: 5 Decision Questions (from stage0 v26 — MANDATORY)
Generate and answer BEFORE proposing paths:

| Code | Question | Kill if... |
|------|----------|------------|
| WINNER | Who is ACTUALLY winning here? Name + mechanism + evidence | Can't name 1 specific person earning ≥$10K/mo NET |
| KILL | What kills this path fastest in 6 months? | ≥7/10 Munger inversion conditions present |
| CUSTOMER | 1 specific person who will pay YOU. Name? Title? Budget? | Can't identify 1 specific buyer |
| ECONOMICS | Math: sell X units × $Y price = $10K/mo. Does math work? | Requires >1000 units/mo at unproven price |
| MOAT | After 12 months, what asset do you own that competitors don't? | Answer = "experience" or "relationships" (non-compounding) |

### Gate B4: Munger 10-Condition Inversion (BLOCKING — AUTO-KILL gate)
For EACH recommended path, list 10 specific conditions that would make it CERTAINLY FAIL. Count how many are currently present.
- 0-3 present → may proceed
- 4-6 present → explicit warning, require user acknowledgment
- **7-10 present → AUTO-KILL. Do NOT recommend this path. Generate alternatives.**

This gate is BLOCKING. No recommendation can ship without passing it.

### Gate B5: Anti-Table Output Rule
Business analysis output MUST be written as **narrative with causal reasoning chains**, not walls of tables.
Tables allowed ONLY for:
- Comparing specific verified numbers (pricing, revenue data)
- Scorecard results (CENTS, inversion counts)
- Quick reference lists

Tables FORBIDDEN for:
- "5 positions with pros/cons" (write as narrative reasoning)
- "30-day plan" (write as prioritized action narrative)
- "daily routine" (this is career coaching, not intelligence)
- Framework comparisons across positions (write as synthesis narrative)

**Why:** Tables create ILLUSION of depth. A table with 5 rows × 4 columns looks analytical but often contains zero causal reasoning. Narrative forces the writer to explain WHY, not just WHAT.

## Anti-Rationalization

| Thought | Reality |
|---------|---------|
| "This is too simple to need a design" | Simple projects = most wasted work from unexamined assumptions. |
| "I already know the solution" | Then writing it down takes 30 seconds. Do it. |
| "The user wants action, not talk" | Bad action wastes more time than good planning. |
| "Let me explore the code first" | Brainstorming tells you HOW to explore. Follow the process. |
| "I'll just prototype quickly" | Prototypes become production code. Design first. |

## Process Flow (Authoritative)

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Scout Project Context] --> B[Ask Clarifying Questions]
    B --> C{Scope too large?}
    C -->|Yes| D[Decompose into Sub-Projects]
    D --> B
    C -->|No| E[Propose 2-3 Approaches]
    E --> F[Present Design Sections]
    F --> G{User Approves?}
    G -->|No| F
    G -->|Yes| H[Write Design Doc / Report]
    H --> I{Create Plan?}
    I -->|Yes| J[Invoke /ck:plan]
    I -->|No| K[End Session]
    J --> L[Journal]
    K --> L
```

**This diagram is the authoritative workflow.** If prose conflicts with this flow, follow the diagram. The terminal state is either `/ck:plan` or end.

## Your Process
1. **Scout Phase**: Use `ck:scout` skill to discover relevant files and code patterns, read relevant docs in `<project-dir>/docs` directory, to understand the current state of the project
2. **Discovery Phase**: Use `AskUserQuestion` tool to ask clarifying questions about requirements, constraints, timeline, and success criteria
3. **Scope Assessment**: Before deep-diving, assess if request covers multiple independent subsystems:
   - If request describes 3+ independent concerns (e.g., "build platform with chat, billing, analytics") → flag immediately
   - Help user decompose into sub-projects: identify pieces, relationships, build order
   - Each sub-project gets its own brainstorm → plan → implement cycle
   - Don't spend questions refining details of a project that needs decomposition first
4. **Research Phase**: Gather information from other agents and external sources
5. **Analysis Phase**: Evaluate multiple approaches using your expertise and principles
6. **Debate Phase**: Use `AskUserQuestion` tool to Present options, challenge user preferences, and work toward the optimal solution
7. **Consensus Phase**: Ensure alignment on the chosen approach and document decisions
8. **Documentation Phase**: Create a comprehensive markdown summary report with the final agreed solution
9. **Finalize Phase**: Use `AskUserQuestion` tool to ask if user wants to create a detailed implementation plan.
   - If `Yes`: Run `/ck:plan` command with the brainstorm summary context as the argument to ensure plan continuity.
     **CRITICAL:** The invoked plan command will create `plan.md` with YAML frontmatter including `status: pending`.
   - If `No`: End the session.
10. **Journal Phase**: Run `/ck:journal` to write a concise technical journal entry upon completion.

## Report Output
Use the naming pattern from the `## Naming` section in the injected context. The pattern includes the full path and computed date.

## Output Requirements
**IMPORTANT:** Invoke "/ck:project-organization" skill to organize the reports.

When brainstorming concludes with agreement, create a detailed markdown summary report including:
- Problem statement and requirements
- Evaluated approaches with pros/cons
- Final recommended solution with rationale
- Implementation considerations and risks
- Success metrics and validation criteria
- Next steps and dependencies
* **IMPORTANT:** Sacrifice grammar for the sake of concision when writing outputs.

## Critical Constraints
- You DO NOT implement solutions yourself - you only brainstorm and advise
- You must validate feasibility before endorsing any approach
- You prioritize long-term maintainability over short-term convenience
- You consider both technical excellence and business pragmatism

**Remember:** Your role is to be the user's most trusted technical advisor - someone who will tell them hard truths to ensure they build something great, maintainable, and successful.

**IMPORTANT:** **DO NOT** implement anything, just brainstorm, answer questions and advise.

## Auto-Evolution Integration (MANDATORY for Content Analysis)

<HARD-GATE id="content-analysis-evolution">
When analyzing external content (TikTok, YouTube, channels, creators, courses, gurus):

**BLOCKING REQUIREMENT:** You MUST run the auto-evolution pipeline BEFORE any manual analysis.
Skipping this gate produces SHALLOW analysis that misses framework-level insights.

**Trigger Detection:**
- URL contains: tiktok.com, youtube.com, @username
- Query contains: "phân tích", "analyze", "evaluate", "review", "đánh giá"
- Topic involves: business, money, wealth, income, passive income, entrepreneurship

**If triggers detected → STOP and run pipeline first.**
</HARD-GATE>

### Pipeline Execution (Step-by-Step)

#### Step 0: Extract Content
```bash
# For TikTok
yt-dlp --flat-playlist --dump-json "https://www.tiktok.com/@{username}" > $TEMP/{username}_dump.json

# For YouTube
yt-dlp --flat-playlist --dump-json "https://www.youtube.com/@{username}" > $TEMP/{username}_dump.json
```

#### Step 1: Run Pipeline Orchestrator
```bash
cd D:/code/invesments/master_investments
.claude/skills/.venv/Scripts/python.exe .claude/skills/business/auto-evolution/scripts/pipeline-orchestrator.py \
  --tiktok-dump $TEMP/{username}_dump.json \
  --markdown
```

This outputs:
- Auto-detected topic domains
- Auto-selected personas (max 5)
- Framework questions to answer
- Synthesis requirements

#### Step 2: INVOKE PERSONAS (CRITICAL - DO NOT SKIP)

For each selected persona, you MUST actually apply their framework:

**Kiyosaki (ESBI Quadrant):**
- Which quadrant (E/S/B/I) does content/creator operate in?
- Asset vs Liability: Teaching asset creation or selling liability?
- Cash Flow: Actual mechanics explained or just concept mentioned?
- Score: Financial education depth (1-10)

**MJ DeMarco (CENTS + Anti-Guru):**
- CENTS Score: Control/Entry/Need/Time/Scale (1-10 each, total /50)
- Fastlane Test: Fastlane, Slowlane, or Sidewalk advice?
- Anti-Guru Test: Makes money FROM this or ABOUT this?
- Process vs Event: Teaching process or promising events?

**Naval Ravikant (Leverage Hierarchy):**
- Leverage Type: Code/Media/Capital/Labor?
- Permissionless: Can do without gatekeepers?
- Specific Knowledge: What unique knowledge taught?
- Accountability: Skin in the game?

**Charlie Munger (Inversion + Mental Models):**
- Inversion: What would make following this fail?
- Biases: Which cognitive biases present?
- Circle of Competence: Creator within expertise?
- Incentive Analysis: Hidden incentives?

**Nassim Taleb (Antifragility + Skin in Game):**
- Skin in Game: Does creator bear downside?
- Fragility: Advice fragile, robust, or antifragile?
- Black Swan: What rare events invalidate this?
- Lindy: Has this survived time?

#### Step 3: Cross-Framework Synthesis

After applying all personas, generate emergent insights:

1. **Agreements:** Where 3+ personas agree → HIGH CONFIDENCE finding
2. **Divergences:** Where personas conflict → requires resolution
3. **Gaps:** What NO persona addressed → blind spot warning
4. **Intersections:**
   - ESBI + Leverage = optimal wealth path
   - CENTS + Asset = transition feasibility
   - Anti-Guru + Accountability = credibility filter

#### Step 4: Red Flag Check (MANDATORY)

| Pattern | Red Flag |
|---------|----------|
| High CTA% + Low mechanism coverage | Funnel, not education |
| "Passive income" x100 + 0 asset mechanics | Motivation porn |
| Billionaire names + 0 framework extraction | Authority theft |
| "I'll help you" CTAs + hidden product | Lead-gen funnel |
| Generic advice + vague success stories | Self-help rehash |

### Report Requirements

Every content analysis report MUST include:

1. **Pipeline Results Section:**
   - Topic domains detected
   - Personas auto-selected
   - CTA% and motivation ratio

2. **Per-Persona Analysis:**
   - Framework applied
   - Score/assessment
   - Gaps identified
   - Recommendation

3. **Synthesis Section:**
   - Cross-framework insights
   - Agreements (with confidence)
   - Divergences (with resolution)
   - Blind spots

4. **Red Flags Section:**
   - Patterns detected
   - Risk assessment

### Failure Mode (What NOT To Do)

❌ **Surface analysis only:** Counting keywords without framework application
❌ **Skip persona invocation:** Pipeline generates prompts but YOU must apply frameworks
❌ **No synthesis:** Running personas without cross-framework analysis
❌ **Missing red flags:** Not checking for guru/funnel patterns

### Success Criteria

✅ All auto-selected personas actually applied (not just listed)
✅ Each persona produces specific scores/assessments
✅ Cross-framework synthesis generates emergent insights
✅ Red flag check completed with explicit pass/fail
✅ Report includes actionable conclusions, not just observations

## Workflow Position

**Typically follows:** `/ck:debug` (brainstorm solutions for diagnosed issues), `/ck:scout` (brainstorm after discovery)
**Typically precedes:** `/ck:plan` (plan the agreed solution)
**Related:** `/ck:plan` (plan after brainstorming), `/ck:debug` (debug before brainstorming)

## Business Intelligence Mode (MANDATORY — triggers on non-dev topics)

<HARD-GATE id="business-mode-detection">
**Mode Detection:** If topic matches ANY of these patterns, activate BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE MODE:
- Money/revenue/income/wealth/cashflow keywords
- Article/URL about a founder, executive, or business success story
- Industry/market/opportunity/investment analysis
- "How to replicate/achieve/become like [person]"
- Vietnamese: "dòng tiền", "kiếm tiền", "cơ hội", "đầu tư", "thâm nhập", "ngành"

**When business mode activates, the following gates become MANDATORY:**
</HARD-GATE>

### Gate B1: Article Narrative Firewall (MM-08 extension)
When user shares a news article about someone's success:
1. **Separate CLAIMS from NARRATIVE.** Article = marketing for the subject. Extract only verifiable claims (title, fund size, revenue, timeline).
2. **Triangulate ALL specific claims** via independent sources (MM-03). Never treat article as ground truth.
3. **Ask Cui Bono (MM-07):** Who benefits from this narrative? (the subject → recruits talent/deal flow; the publication → clicks; the ecosystem → attracts capital)
4. **Map ACTUAL position in value chain** — not title/brand, but FUNCTION and DECISION POWER. Title "Director" can mean decision-maker or scout.
5. **Calculate ACTUAL income/wealth** from the position, not implied by title. "Director of $450M fund" ≠ earns $450M.

### Gate B2: Money-Flow Trace (BLOCKING — before any recommendation)
Before proposing ANY path/position/opportunity, trace the COMPLETE money flow:
```
Source of money → Who decides allocation → Intermediaries → Destination → Returns path → Feedback loop
```
At each node, identify:
- **Who decides?** (name/role level, not generic "the board")
- **What criteria?** (what makes them say yes)
- **What bottleneck?** (what's scarce at this node)
- **What gatekeeper?** (who controls access)
- **Cycle time?** (how long from input to output at this node)

Then find: **Which bottleneck node can 1 person with the user's SPECIFIC profile insert themselves into?**

### Gate B3: 5 Decision Questions (from stage0 v26 — MANDATORY)
Generate and answer BEFORE proposing paths:

| Code | Question | Kill if... |
|------|----------|------------|
| WINNER | Who is ACTUALLY winning here? Name + mechanism + evidence | Can't name 1 specific person earning ≥$10K/mo NET |
| KILL | What kills this path fastest in 6 months? | ≥7/10 Munger inversion conditions present |
| CUSTOMER | 1 specific person who will pay YOU. Name? Title? Budget? | Can't identify 1 specific buyer |
| ECONOMICS | Math: sell X units × $Y price = $10K/mo. Does math work? | Requires >1000 units/mo at unproven price |
| MOAT | After 12 months, what asset do you own that competitors don't? | Answer = "experience" or "relationships" (non-compounding) |

### Gate B4: Munger 10-Condition Inversion (BLOCKING — AUTO-KILL gate)
For EACH recommended path, list 10 specific conditions that would make it CERTAINLY FAIL. Count how many are currently present.
- 0-3 present → may proceed
- 4-6 present → explicit warning, require user acknowledgment
- **7-10 present → AUTO-KILL. Do NOT recommend this path. Generate alternatives.**

This gate is BLOCKING. No recommendation can ship without passing it.

### Gate B5: Anti-Table Output Rule
Business analysis output MUST be written as **narrative with causal reasoning chains**, not walls of tables.
Tables allowed ONLY for:
- Comparing specific verified numbers (pricing, revenue data)
- Scorecard results (CENTS, inversion counts)
- Quick reference lists

Tables FORBIDDEN for:
- "5 positions with pros/cons" (write as narrative reasoning)
- "30-day plan" (write as prioritized action narrative)
- "daily routine" (this is career coaching, not intelligence)
- Framework comparisons across positions (write as synthesis narrative)

**Why:** Tables create ILLUSION of depth. A table with 5 rows × 4 columns looks analytical but often contains zero causal reasoning. Narrative forces the writer to explain WHY, not just WHAT.

## Anti-Rationalization

| Thought | Reality |
|---------|---------|
| "This is too simple to need a design" | Simple projects = most wasted work from unexamined assumptions. |
| "I already know the solution" | Then writing it down takes 30 seconds. Do it. |
| "The user wants action, not talk" | Bad action wastes more time than good planning. |
| "Let me explore the code first" | Brainstorming tells you HOW to explore. Follow the process. |
| "I'll just prototype quickly" | Prototypes become production code. Design first. |

#### Step 2: INVOKE PERSONAS (CRITICAL - DO NOT SKIP)

For each selected persona, you MUST actually apply their framework:

**Kiyosaki (ESBI Quadrant):**
- Which quadrant (E/S/B/I) does content/creator operate in?
- Asset vs Liability: Teaching asset creation or selling liability?
- Cash Flow: Actual mechanics explained or just concept mentioned?
- Score: Financial education depth (1-10)

**MJ DeMarco (CENTS + Anti-Guru):**
- CENTS Score: Control/Entry/Need/Time/Scale (1-10 each, total /50)
- Fastlane Test: Fastlane, Slowlane, or Sidewalk advice?
- Anti-Guru Test: Makes money FROM this or ABOUT this?
- Process vs Event: Teaching process or promising events?

**Naval Ravikant (Leverage Hierarchy):**
- Leverage Type: Code/Media/Capital/Labor?
- Permissionless: Can do without gatekeepers?
- Specific Knowledge: What unique knowledge taught?
- Accountability: Skin in the game?

**Charlie Munger (Inversion + Mental Models):**
- Inversion: What would make following this fail?
- Biases: Which cognitive biases present?
- Circle of Competence: Creator within expertise?
- Incentive Analysis: Hidden incentives?

**Nassim Taleb (Antifragility + Skin in Game):**
- Skin in Game: Does creator bear downside?
- Fragility: Advice fragile, robust, or antifragile?
- Black Swan: What rare events invalidate this?
- Lindy: Has this survived time?

#### Step 3: Cross-Framework Synthesis

After applying all personas, generate emergent insights:

1. **Agreements:** Where 3+ personas agree → HIGH CONFIDENCE finding
2. **Divergences:** Where personas conflict → requires resolution
3. **Gaps:** What NO persona addressed → blind spot warning
4. **Intersections:**
   - ESBI + Leverage = optimal wealth path
   - CENTS + Asset = transition feasibility
   - Anti-Guru + Accountability = credibility filter

#### Step 4: Red Flag Check (MANDATORY)

| Pattern | Red Flag |
|---------|----------|
| High CTA% + Low mechanism coverage | Funnel, not education |
| "Passive income" x100 + 0 asset mechanics | Motivation porn |
| Billionaire names + 0 framework extraction | Authority theft |
| "I'll help you" CTAs + hidden product | Lead-gen funnel |
| Generic advice + vague success stories | Self-help rehash |

type ApiError =
  | { type: 'network'; retryable: true }
  | { type: 'auth'; retryable: false }
  | { type: 'notFound'; resource: string }
  | { type: 'validation'; fields: Record<string, string> };

type Result<T, E = ApiError> = { ok: true; data: T } | { ok: false; error: E };

async function getUser(id: string): Promise<Result<User>> {
  try {
    const res = await this.http.get(`/users/${id}`);
    return { ok: true, data: res.data };

  }
}

"""
Stage0Bridge — non-blocking adapter to inject decomposition facts into Stage0 cases.
Limited to 20 queries max for speed. Catches all exceptions.
"""

import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable, Optional

from .compound_cache import CompoundCache
from .decomposer import Decomposer
from .fact_assembler import FactAssembler
from .founder_capabilities import FounderCapabilitiesDB
from .micro_query_runner import MicroQueryRunner
from .template_evolver import TemplateEvolver

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
DEFAULT_VECTORS_DB = ROOT / ".claude" / "data" / "knowledge-distillation" / "decision-vectors.db"

MAX_QUERIES_STAGE0 = 20


class Stage0Bridge:
    def __init__(
        self,
        research_fn: Callable[[str], str],
        vectors_db: Optional[Path] = None,
    ):
        self.research_fn = research_fn
        self.vectors_db = vectors_db or DEFAULT_VECTORS_DB

    def pre_decompose(self, case: dict) -> dict:
        """Enrich case with pre-decomposition facts. Non-blocking: returns original on failure."""
        try:
            return self._do_decompose(case)
        except Exception:
            return case

    def _do_decompose(self, case: dict) -> dict:
        description = (
            case.get("opportunity_description")
            or case.get("description")
            or case.get("query")
            or ""
        )
        if not description:
            return case

        start = time.time()
        decomposer = Decomposer()
        tree = decomposer.decompose(description)

        queries = tree.queries_to_fire[:MAX_QUERIES_STAGE0]
        if not queries:
            return case

        runner = MicroQueryRunner(research_fn=self.research_fn, batch_delay=0.3)
        results, stats = runner.run_batch(queries)

        assembler = FactAssembler(vectors_db=self.vectors_db)
        domain = tree.context.get("industry", "general")
        assembly = assembler.assemble(results, domain=domain)

        facts = []
        evolver = TemplateEvolver()
        for i, r in enumerate(results):
            if r.parse_success and r.parsed_fact:
                facts.append({
                    "fact_id": f"FACT-{i+1:03d}",
                    "query": r.query.text,
                    "dimension": r.query.dimension,
                    **r.parsed_fact,
                })
                evolver.record_template_usage(
                    dimension=r.query.dimension,
                    template_text=r.query.text,
                    facts_produced=1,
                    avg_confidence=r.parsed_fact.get("confidence", 0.5),
                    parse_success=1.0,
                )
            else:
                evolver.record_template_usage(
                    dimension=r.query.dimension,
                    template_text=r.query.text,
                    facts_produced=0,
                    avg_confidence=0.0,
                    parse_success=0.0,
                )
        evolver.evolve_weights()

        caps_db = FounderCapabilitiesDB()
        founder_state = caps_db.load()
        if founder_state:
            case["founder_context"] = founder_state.to_dict()

        case["pre_decomposition_facts"] = facts
        case["pre_decomposition_meta"] = {
            "dimensions_decomposed": len(tree.dimensions),
            "queries_fired": stats.queries_fired,
            "facts_pre_loaded": len(facts),
            "facts_stored": assembly.facts_added,
            "duration_ms": int((time.time() - start) * 1000),
        }

        return case

    def pre_analyze(self, case: dict) -> dict:
        """Run technique engine on pre-decomposed facts. Non-blocking."""
        try:
            return self._do_analyze(case)
        except Exception:
            return case

    def _do_analyze(self, case: dict) -> dict:
        raw_facts = case.get("pre_decomposition_facts", [])
        if not raw_facts:
            return case

        from ..hunger.claim_parser import ParsedClaim

        from ..reasoning.techniques.technique_registry import build_default_orchestrator
        from ..strategy.synthesizer import StrategicSynthesizer

"""
ThinkRunner — standalone orchestrator for /think command.
Full pipeline: decompose → run queries → assemble facts → synthesize.
"""

import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable, Optional

from .compound_cache import CompoundCache
from .decomposer import Decomposer
from .fact_assembler import FactAssembler
from .micro_query_runner import MicroQueryRunner
from .synthesis_engine import SynthesisEngine, SynthesisResult
from .template_evolver import TemplateEvolver

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
DEFAULT_VECTORS_DB = ROOT / ".claude" / "data" / "knowledge-distillation" / "decision-vectors.db"
DEFAULT_EVOLUTION_DB = ROOT / ".claude" / "data" / "decomposition" / "evolution.db"


class ThinkRunner:
    def __init__(
        self,
        research_fn: Callable[[str], str],
        vectors_db: Optional[Path] = None,
        evolution_db: Optional[Path] = None,
    ):
        self.research_fn = research_fn
        self.vectors_db = vectors_db or DEFAULT_VECTORS_DB
        self.evolution_db = evolution_db or DEFAULT_EVOLUTION_DB
        self.cache = CompoundCache(db_path=self.vectors_db)
        self.evolver = TemplateEvolver(db_path=self.evolution_db)

    def think(self, query: str, progress_fn: Optional[Callable[[str], None]] = None) -> SynthesisResult:
        start = time.time()

        def log(msg: str) -> None:
            if progress_fn:
                progress_fn(msg)

        evolved_weights = self.evolver.get_evolved_weights() or None
        decomposer = Decomposer(weight_overrides=evolved_weights)
        tree = decomposer.decompose(query)
        log(f"Decomposed: {tree.total_queries} micro-queries across {len(tree.dimensions)} dimensions")

        cached_facts = []
        for dim in tree.dimensions:
            cached = self.cache.lookup(dim.name, tree.context)
            cached_facts.extend(cached)

        queries_to_fire = tree.queries_to_fire
        cached_count = tree.total_queries - len(queries_to_fire)
        log(f"Researching: {len(queries_to_fire)} queries ({cached_count} cached)")

        runner = MicroQueryRunner(research_fn=self.research_fn, batch_delay=0.5)
        results, stats = runner.run_batch(queries_to_fire)

        assembler = FactAssembler(vectors_db=self.vectors_db)
        domain = tree.context.get("industry", "general")
        assembly = assembler.assemble(results, domain=domain)
        log(f"Assembled: {assembly.facts_added} new facts, {assembly.duplicates} duplicates")

        all_facts = list(cached_facts)
        from ..hunger.claim_parser import ParsedClaim
        for r in results:
            if r.parse_success and r.parsed_fact:
                f = r.parsed_fact
                all_facts.append(ParsedClaim(
                    fact=f.get("fact", ""),
                    value=self._parse_float(f.get("value")),
                    dimension=self._map_dim(r.query.dimension),
                    source_url=f.get("source"),
                    source_date=f.get("date"),
                    confidence=f.get("confidence", 0.5),
                    zone_tag="K" if f.get("confidence", 0) >= 0.75 else "T" if f.get("confidence", 0) >= 0.5 else "?",
                ))

        engine = SynthesisEngine()
        result = engine.synthesize(tree, all_facts)
        log(f"Synthesized: score={result.overall_score:.2f}, {result.facts_used} facts used")

        try:
            from ..reasoning.techniques import TechniqueOrchestrator, TechniqueInput, FallbackRouter
            from ..strategy.synthesizer import StrategicSynthesizer
            from ..reasoning.techniques.technique_registry import build_default_orchestrator

            tech_input = TechniqueInput(
                facts=all_facts,
                context=tree.context,
                founder_context=self._load_founder_context(),
                ecosystem_map=self._load_ecosystem_map(tree.context),
                vectors_db=self.vectors_db,
                kill_signals=self._load_kill_signals(),
            )

            orchestrator = build_default_orchestrator()
            orch_result = orchestrator.run_all(tech_input)

            if orch_result.needs_data_dimensions:
                fallback = FallbackRouter(research_fn=self._wrap_research_fn())
                new_facts = fallback.route(orch_result.needs_data_dimensions, tree.context)
                if new_facts:
                    enriched_input = TechniqueInput(
                        facts=tech_input.facts + new_facts,
                        context=tech_input.context,
                        founder_context=tech_input.founder_context,
                        ecosystem_map=tech_input.ecosystem_map,
                        vectors_db=tech_input.vectors_db,
                        kill_signals=tech_input.kill_signals,
                    )
                    orch_result = orchestrator.run_all(enriched_input)

            dim_scores_for_strategy = {
                k: v.score for k, v in result.dimension_scores.items()
            }
            strategist = StrategicSynthesizer()
            strategy = strategist.synthesize(
                dim_scores_for_strategy, tech_input.founder_context, self.vectors_db
            )

            result.technique_results = orch_result.to_dict()
            result.strategy = strategy.to_dict()
            log(f"Techniques: consensus={orch_result.consensus}, strategy_weeks={strategy.total_timeline_weeks}")
        except Exception as e:
            result.technique_results = {"error": str(e), "status": "failed"}
            result.strategy = None

        duration_ms = int((time.time() - start) * 1000)
        self.evolver.record_run(
            query=query, query_type=tree.query_type,
            dimensions_used=len(tree.dimensions),
            queries_fired=stats.queries_fired,
            facts_added=assembly.facts_added,
            facts_reused=len(cached_facts),
            overall_score=result.overall_score,
            duration_ms=duration_ms,
        )

        for r in results:
            if r.parse_success:
                self.evolver.record_template_usage(
                    dimension=r.query.dimension,
                    template_text=r.query.text[:200],
                    facts_produced=1,
                    avg_confidence=r.parsed_fact.get("confidence", 0.5) if r.parsed_fact else 0,
                    parse_success=1.0,
                )
            else:
                self.evolver.record_template_usage(
                    dimension=r.query.dimension,
                    template_text=r.query.text[:200],
                    facts_produced=0,
                    avg_confidence=0.0,
                    parse_success=0.0,
                )

        return result

    def format(self, result: SynthesisResult) -> str:
        engine = SynthesisEngine()
        return engine.format_output(result)

    def _parse_float(self, val) -> Optional[float]:
        if val is None:
            return None
        try:
            return float(val)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return None

    def _load_founder_context(self) -> dict:
        founder_path = ROOT / ".claude" / "data" / "founder-profile.json"
        if founder_path.exists():
            import json
            with founder_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        return {"capital_usd": 1000, "hours_per_day": 4, "skills": []}

    def _load_ecosystem_map(self, context: dict) -> dict:
        return context.get("ecosystem_map", {"players": [], "value_chain": []})

    def _load_kill_signals(self) -> list:
        import json
        ks_path = ROOT / ".claude" / "data" / "knowledge-distillation" / "kill-signals.json"
        if ks_path.exists():
            with ks_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f).get("signals", [])
        return []

    def _wrap_research_fn(self):
        import json
        def wrapped(query: str):
            raw = self.research_fn(query)
            if not raw:
                return None
            try:
                return json.loads(raw) if isinstance(raw, str) else raw
            except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
                return {"fact": str(raw)[:200], "confidence": 0.4}
        return wrapped

    def _map_dim(self, decomp_dim: str) -> str:
        mapping = {
            "base_rates": "failure_rates", "failure_patterns": "failure_rates",
            "competitive_landscape": "competitive_landscape",
            "unit_economics": "unit_economics", "moat_patterns": "moat_patterns",
            "timing_windows": "timing_windows", "regulatory_risks": "regulatory_risks",
            "compounding_mechanisms": "compounding_mechanisms",
            "career_path": "founder_paths", "founder_experience": "founder_paths",
            "capital_requirements": "unit_economics", "deal_skills": "unit_economics",
            "execution_distance": "founder_paths", "leverage_type": "compounding_mechanisms",
            "network_access": "founder_paths", "indirect_entry": "founder_paths",
        }
        return mapping.get(decomp_dim, "failure_rates")

34	            "query": self.query,

36	            "overall_score": round(self.overall_score, 3),
37	            "dimension_scores": {k: v.to_dict() for k, v in self.dimension_scores.items()},

39	            "path": [p.to_dict() for p in self.path],
40	            "facts_used": self.facts_used,
41	            "facts_by_zone": self.facts_by_zone,
42	            "llm_calls_made": self.llm_calls_made,

44	        }
45	        if self.technique_results:
46	            d["technique_results"] = self.technique_results
47	        if self.strategy:
48	            d["strategy"] = self.strategy
49	        return d

52	class SynthesisEngine:
53	    def __init__(self):
54	        self.scorer = DimensionScorer()
55	        self.gap_analyzer = GapAnalyzer()
56	        self.path_generator = PathGenerator()
57	        self.formatter = OutputFormatter()

59	    def synthesize(self, tree: DecompositionTree, facts: list[ParsedClaim]) -> SynthesisResult:
60	        facts_by_dim = self._group_by_dimension(facts, tree)
61	        dim_scores = self.scorer.score_all(facts_by_dim)
62	
63	        for dim in tree.dimensions:
64	            if dim.name not in dim_scores:
65	                dim_scores[dim.name] = self.scorer.score(dim.name, [])
66	
67	        gaps = self.gap_analyzer.analyze(tree, dim_scores)
68	        path = self.path_generator.generate(tree.query_type, dim_scores, tree.context)
69	
70	        scored_dims = [ds for ds in dim_scores.values() if ds.fact_count > 0]
71	        overall = (
72	            sum(ds.score * self._get_weight(ds.dimension, tree) for ds in scored_dims)
73	            / max(sum(self._get_weight(ds.dimension, tree) for ds in scored_dims), 1.0)
74	        ) if scored_dims else 0.0
75	
76	        zone_counts = {"K": 0, "T": 0, "?": 0}
77	        for f in facts:
78	            tag = f.zone_tag if f.zone_tag in zone_counts else "?"
79	            zone_counts[tag] += 1
80	
81	        recommendations = self._generate_recommendations(dim_scores, gaps)
82	
83	        result = SynthesisResult(
84	            query=tree.original_query,
85	            query_type=tree.query_type,
86	            overall_score=overall,
87	            dimension_scores=dim_scores,
88	            gaps=gaps,
89	            path=path,
90	            facts_used=len(facts),
91	            facts_by_zone=zone_counts,
92	            llm_calls_made=0,

94	        )

96	        assert result.llm_calls_made == 0, "SynthesisEngine must be LOCAL-only"

99	    def format_output(self, result: SynthesisResult) -> str:

101

"""
SynthesisEngine — LOCAL-ONLY orchestrator for dimension scoring, gap analysis,
path generation, and output formatting. Zero LLM calls enforced.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Optional

from ..hunger.claim_parser import ParsedClaim
from .decomposer import DecompositionTree
from .dimension_scorer import DimensionScore, DimensionScorer
from .gap_analyzer import GapAnalyzer, GapReport
from .output_formatter import OutputFormatter
from .path_generator import PathGenerator, PathStep


@dataclass
class SynthesisResult:
    query: str
    query_type: str
    overall_score: float
    dimension_scores: dict[str, DimensionScore]
    gaps: list[GapReport]
    path: list[PathStep]
    facts_used: int
    facts_by_zone: dict[str, int]
    llm_calls_made: int
    recommendations: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    technique_results: Optional[dict] = None
    strategy: Optional[dict] = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        d = {
            "query": self.query,
            "query_type": self.query_type,
            "overall_score": round(self.overall_score, 3),
            "dimension_scores": {k: v.to_dict() for k, v in self.dimension_scores.items()},
            "gaps": [g.to_dict() for g in self.gaps],
            "path": [p.to_dict() for p in self.path],
            "facts_used": self.facts_used,
            "facts_by_zone": self.facts_by_zone,
            "llm_calls_made": self.llm_calls_made,
            "recommendations": self.recommendations,
        }
        if self.technique_results:
            d["technique_results"] = self.technique_results
        if self.strategy:
            d["strategy"] = self.strategy
        return d


class SynthesisEngine:
    def __init__(self):
        self.scorer = DimensionScorer()
        self.gap_analyzer = GapAnalyzer()
        self.path_generator = PathGenerator()
        self.formatter = OutputFormatter()

    def synthesize(self, tree: DecompositionTree, facts: list[ParsedClaim]) -> SynthesisResult:
        facts_by_dim = self._group_by_dimension(facts, tree)
        dim_scores = self.scorer.score_all(facts_by_dim)

        for dim in tree.dimensions:
            if dim.name not in dim_scores:
                dim_scores[dim.name] = self.scorer.score(dim.name, [])

        gaps = self.gap_analyzer.analyze(tree, dim_scores)
        path = self.path_generator.generate(tree.query_type, dim_scores, tree.context)

        scored_dims = [ds for ds in dim_scores.values() if ds.fact_count > 0]
        overall = (
            sum(ds.score * self._get_weight(ds.dimension, tree) for ds in scored_dims)
            / max(sum(self._get_weight(ds.dimension, tree) for ds in scored_dims), 1.0)
        ) if scored_dims else 0.0

        zone_counts = {"K": 0, "T": 0, "?": 0}
        for f in facts:
            tag = f.zone_tag if f.zone_tag in zone_counts else "?"
            zone_counts[tag] += 1

        recommendations = self._generate_recommendations(dim_scores, gaps)

        result = SynthesisResult(
            query=tree.original_query,
            query_type=tree.query_type,
            overall_score=overall,
            dimension_scores=dim_scores,
            gaps=gaps,
            path=path,
            facts_used=len(facts),
            facts_by_zone=zone_counts,
            llm_calls_made=0,
            recommendations=recommendations,
        )

        assert result.llm_calls_made == 0, "SynthesisEngine must be LOCAL-only"
        return result

    def format_output(self, result: SynthesisResult) -> str:
        return self.formatter.format(result)

    def _group_by_dimension(
        self, facts: list[ParsedClaim], tree: DecompositionTree,
    ) -> dict[str, list[ParsedClaim]]:
        dim_map = self._build_claim_dimension_map()
        grouped: dict[str, list[ParsedClaim]] = {}
        tree_dims = {d.name for d in tree.dimensions}

        for fact in facts:
            decomp_dim = dim_map.get(fact.dimension)
            if decomp_dim and decomp_dim in tree_dims:
                grouped.setdefault(decomp_dim, []).append(fact)
            else:
                for dim_name in tree_dims:
                    if dim_name in fact.fact.lower() or fact.dimension in dim_name:
                        grouped.setdefault(dim_name, []).append(fact)
                        break

        return grouped

    def _build_claim_dimension_map(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        return {
            "failure_rates": "failure_patterns",
            "unit_economics": "unit_economics",
            "competitive_landscape": "competitive_landscape",
            "moat_patterns": "moat_patterns",
            "founder_paths": "founder_experience",
            "timing_windows": "timing_windows",
            "regulatory_risks": "regulatory_risks",
            "compounding_mechanisms": "compounding_mechanisms",
        }

    def _get_weight(self, dimension: str, tree: DecompositionTree) -> float:
        for dim in tree.dimensions:
            if dim.name == dimension:
                return dim.weight
        return 1.0

    def _generate_recommendations(
        self, scores: dict[str, DimensionScore], gaps: list[GapReport],
    ) -> list[str]:
        recs = []
        high_conf = [ds for ds in scores.values() if ds.zone_tag == "K"]
        if high_conf:
            dims = ", ".join(ds.dimension for ds in high_conf[:3])
            recs.append(f"Strong evidence in: {dims}")

        critical_gaps = [g for g in gaps if g.priority >= 2.0]
        if critical_gaps:
            dims = ", ".join(g.dimension for g in critical_gaps[:3])
            recs.append(f"Critical gaps to research: {dims}")

        contradicted = [ds for ds in scores.values() if ds.contradictions > 0]
        if contradicted:
            dims = ", ".join(ds.dimension for ds in contradicted[:3])
            recs.append(f"Contradictions found in: {dims} — resolve before deciding")

        return recs
